bc_fern_gully_2.blurb: Fern Gully is a small single-pitch crag inside the Smoke Bluffs park in Squamish, tucked up the hill from the Penny Lane wall. Seven routes are recorded, most of them traditional lines on moderate ground from low-fifth-class up to 5.8, with the remaining two being bolted sport lines at 5.11. Routes run roughly 12 to 35 metres. A standard rack covers the cracks, and a few extra mid-size cams are useful on the easier ones. Getting there means a walk of about a quarter of an hour uphill from the parking lot, using the gully at the right-hand end of the Penny Lane wall.
